scripts.db:dump: wrangler kv key list --binding TICKETS --local | jq -r '.[].name' | while IFS= read -r key; do printf '\n%s\n' "$key"; wrangler kv key get "$key" --binding TICKETS --local --text; done
scripts.check: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
